Filecoin Cloud

Storage, retrieval, and payments in one SDK

The same network preserving the Internet Archive's data, available to you as infrastructure: store data with a verified proof, fetch it fast, and pay for exactly what you use, all from one TypeScript SDK.

  • Warm Storage with Proof of Data Possession

    Providers prove they hold your data on a fixed schedule. Miss a proof, lose the payment.

  • Fast retrieval with Filecoin Beam

    CDN-class egress for the data you store, paid per byte served.

  • Programmable payments with Filecoin Pay

    Stream payments in USDFC or FIL. Budgets, rails, and settlements live onchain.

Read the quickstartExplore Filecoin Cloud

3import { privateKeyToAccount } from 'viem/accounts'
4import { http } from 'viem'
5
6// Get credentials from your developer dashboard
7const account = privateKeyToAccount(process.env.FILECOIN_PRIVATE_KEY)
8const synapse = await Synapse.create({
9  account,
10  chain: calibration,
11  transport: http(),
12})
13
14// Store a file, get back its content identifier
15const { pieceCid } = await synapse.storage.upload(bytes)
16
17// Retrieve it from any provider with a valid proof
18const bytes = await synapse.storage.download({ pieceCid })

One network, a path for every team

Pick the way you want to consume Filecoin: programmable primitives, a managed S3 service, or capacity you supply.

Storage that agents can pay for themselves

Give autonomous agents a place to persist memory, artifacts, and datasets with a budget they control through Filecoin Pay.

Every write returns a content identifier, so agents and the humans supervising them can verify exactly what was stored.

Build with agents

Ship verifiable storage in an afternoon

Install the Synapse SDK, fund a wallet, and store your first file with a proof attached. No storage provider negotiations, no proprietary formats, no lock-in.

Everything is open source and content addressed, so the data you store today is retrievable from any provider tomorrow.

Read the docs

Storage your auditors can verify

Replace opaque SLAs with cryptographic proofs. Filecoin shows you, onchain, that every replica of your data exists and is intact, every day.

Choose programmable primitives for your own products or a managed S3-compatible service through Fil One. Both run on the same verifiable network.

Talk to sales

Cloud economics that scale with you, not against you

Pay only for what you store, with no egress surprises and pricing you can read in a smart contract instead of a 40-page rate card.

Start on a managed service, move to the SDK when you need control. Your data never has to migrate.

Compare storage options

Turn spare capacity into recurring revenue

Storage providers earn by proving they hold customer data. Filecoin Pay settles in stablecoins, so revenue is predictable.

Join thousands of providers already serving enterprises and archives worldwide.
